# Error Handling Checklist: ART-005 - Gallery Completion - Knowledge, Reports & Editors

**Purpose**: Validate error-handling requirement quality for ART-005 clipboard export recovery, repeated attempts, direct `file://` behavior, and accessible manual copy before task generation and implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist error-handling` workflow based on feature context and requirements.

## Failure-Mode Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is clipboard absence defined as a recoverable path rather than an implementation exception? [Completeness, Spec §Clipboard behavior]
- [x] CHK002 Is a synchronously throwing `navigator.clipboard.writeText()` handled by the same visible recovery contract as asynchronous refusal? [Completeness, Contract §Shared Clipboard Protocol]
- [x] CHK003 Are a non-callable `writeText`, permission denial such as `NotAllowedError`, and a generic rejected promise specified as distinct probes with the same observable recovery outcome? [Resolved] [Spec §Clipboard behavior, Contract §Shared Clipboard Protocol]
- [x] CHK004 Is genuine clipboard success required separately from every forced failure path? [Completeness, Contract §UAT Evidence]
- [x] CHK005 Is the implementation limited to at most one clipboard write attempt per invocation? [Completeness, Data Model §ClipboardAttempt]
- [x] CHK006 Is the clipboard object read at invocation time so a stale startup capability decision cannot bypass recovery? [Clarity, Design Concept §Q5]

## Recovery Contract Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the failure message exact, visible, and programmatically announced without guessing or exposing a browser-specific cause? [Clarity, Contract §Shared Clipboard Protocol]
- [x] CHK008 Is the fallback a visible labeled selectable textarea containing the exact attempted export string? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK009 Is focus required to move to the fallback textarea on every current failure path? [Accessibility, Spec §Clipboard behavior]
- [x] CHK010 Are hidden `execCommand` copying, automatic download, silent failure, import, persistence, URL state, and server recovery prohibited? [Scope, Contract §Shared Clipboard Protocol]
- [x] CHK011 Must each invocation clear the prior status, hide the prior fallback, and empty its text before creating the new snapshot? [Clarity, Contract §Fresh Snapshot Protocol]
- [x] CHK012 After a failure followed by success, is the stale fallback required to remain hidden and empty while focus remains on the invoked export control? [Resolved] [Contract §Fresh Snapshot Protocol, Data Model §ClipboardAttempt]

## Repeated And Concurrent Attempts

- [x] CHK013 Is each attempted export serialized once and reused byte-for-byte for both clipboard and fallback paths? [Consistency, Spec §Fresh export snapshots]
- [x] CHK014 Does a later invocation supersede every earlier unsettled attempt? [Clarity, Contract §Fresh Snapshot Protocol]
- [x] CHK015 Is an older delayed failure forbidden from replacing a newer success status, revealing fallback, or stealing focus? [Completeness, Contract §Fresh Snapshot Protocol]
- [x] CHK016 Is an older delayed success forbidden from replacing a newer failure status, hiding fallback, changing its contents, or stealing focus? [Completeness, Contract §Fresh Snapshot Protocol]
- [x] CHK017 Does a repeated current failure replace the fallback with the latest attempted export rather than append, retain, or merge stale text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK018 Is a normal failure-to-success-to-failure sequence specified with observable status, fallback visibility/content, and focus expectations after every step? [Resolved] [Contract §UAT Evidence]

## Acceptance Evidence Quality

- [x] CHK019 Does UAT execute directly over `file://` rather than inferring clipboard behavior from an HTTP origin? [Acceptance Criteria, Contract §UAT Evidence]
- [x] CHK020 Does every producer have rows for unavailable clipboard, permission denial, generic rejection, and synchronous throw? [Coverage, Contract §UAT Evidence]
- [x] CHK021 Does every forced-failure row compare the fallback byte-for-byte with that invocation's attempted export? [Acceptance Criteria, Contract §UAT Evidence]
- [x] CHK022 Does every forced-failure row verify the exact status text, fallback label/selectability, visibility, and focused target? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK023 Do race rows exercise both settlement directions and prove stale status, fallback contents, visibility, and focus are unchanged? [Coverage, Contract §UAT Evidence]
- [x] CHK024 Does the UAT row schema capture failure kind, clipboard method shape, write-attempt count, attempted export equality, exact status, fallback state, and focused target without relying on prose alone? [Resolved] [Contract §UAT Evidence]
- [x] CHK025 Is genuine success proven with clipboard read-back or paste equality and no visible fallback? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK026 Are reader-only artifacts explicitly `not_applicable` for producer recovery cases with a reason? [Coverage, Contract §UAT Evidence]

## Consistency And Scope

- [x] CHK027 Are the spec, editor export contract, data model, quickstart, and UAT contract consistent about the exact two status messages? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK028 Are keyboard and screen-reader recovery requirements consistent with the accessibility checklist and persistent status-region contract? [Consistency, Checklist §accessibility]
- [x] CHK029 Do the requirements preserve memory-only state and avoid adding a second export kind or recovery channel? [Scope, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK030 Do the existing per-slice ceilings remain below 800 LOC after error-handling clarification? [Scope, Plan §Reviewability Checkpoint]
